derivation: Derived GEOMETRICALLY from the real TY2025 f1040s8.pdf (Schedule 8812) (IRS fillable form): for every entry, the widget /Rect of the field (read with pypdf) was matched against the printed line labels extracted with `pdftotext -bbox` on the blank form; a field is assigned to the line whose printed label sits on the same row (widget y-center within ~6pt of the label row) and, for table columns, whose x-band matches the printed column. Checkbox on-states were read from each widget's /AP /N appearance keys with pypdf. IRS publishes this form as f1040s8.pdf; the packet's canonical template name is f10408812.pdf. Counts (lines 4, 6, and the 16b count box) are kind 'count' (integer text, not money). Line 12's Yes/No boxes are c1_1[0] (/1, on the printed 'No. Stop here.' row) and c1_1[1] (/2, on the 'Yes. Subtract line 11 from line 8.' row) — printed order is No first. Part II-A line 19's boxes: c2_1[0] (/1, 'No' row) and c2_1[1] (/2, 'Yes' row), with the line 19 amount in the mid column (f2_8). The 'Next. On line 16b, is the amount $5,100 or more?' boxes are c2_2[0] (/1, No) and c2_2[1] (/2, Yes). Part II-B fields (lines 21-26) are NOT mapped: Part II-B is not implemented in v1 (see KNOWN_LIMITS).

entries.note: 'Name(s) shown on return' field; filled from the stored identity when present.
'Your social security number' field; digits-only; report value masked.
Line 1 (Form 1040 line 11 AGI); widget row y-center 654 matches the printed '1' label row.
Line 3 'Add lines 1 and 2d' (lines 2a-2d excluded-income items are blank in v1, so line 3 = line 1 = MAGI); widget row matches the printed '3' label row.
Line 4 'Number of qualifying children under age 17 with the required social security number' mid-column count field; widget row matches the printed '4' label row.
Line 5 (line 4 x $2,200); widget row matches the printed '5' label row.
Line 6 'Number of other dependents...' mid-column count field; widget row matches the printed '6' label rows.
Line 7 (line 6 x $500); widget row matches the printed '7' label row.
Line 8 'Add lines 5 and 7' (tentative credit); widget row matches the printed '8' label row.
Line 9 phaseout threshold for the filing status ($400,000 MFJ / $200,000 all others in TY2025); widget row matches the printed '9' label rows.
Line 10 (line 3 minus line 9, rounded up to the next multiple of $1,000); widget row matches the printed '10' label rows.
Line 11 'Multiply line 10 by 5%' (phaseout reduction); widget row matches the printed '11' label row.
Line 12 question No box ('No. Stop here. You cannot take the child tax credit...'); on-state /1.
Line 12 question Yes box ('Yes. Subtract line 11 from line 8.'); on-state /2.
Line 12 amount (line 8 minus line 11, floor zero); widget row matches the printed '12' label row.
Line 13 'Enter the amount from Credit Limit Worksheet A' (in v1 the worksheet result is Form 1040 line 16; see worksheets.rs); widget row matches the printed '13' label row.
Line 14 'Enter the smaller of line 12 or line 13' (nonrefundable child tax credit + credit for other dependents), flows to Form 1040 line 19; widget row matches the printed '14' label rows.
Part II-A line 16a 'Subtract line 14 from line 12'; widget row matches the printed '16a' label row (page 2).
Part II-A line 16b count box ('Number of qualifying children under age 17 with the required social security number: __ x $1,700'), mid-row field x 376.1-435.6; same count as line 4.
Part II-A line 16b amount (16b count x $1,700 ACTC cap per child); widget row matches the printed '16b' label rows.
Part II-A line 17 'Enter the smaller of line 16a or line 16b'; widget row matches the printed '17' label row.
Part II-A line 18a 'Earned income' mid-column field; widget row matches the printed '18a' label row.
Line 19 question ('Is the amount on line 18a more than $2,500?') No box; on-state /1.
Line 19 question Yes box; on-state /2.
Line 19 amount (line 18a minus $2,500) mid-column field; filled only on the Yes branch (the form leaves it blank on No).
Line 20 'Multiply the amount on line 19 by 15%'; widget row matches the printed '20' label row.
'On line 16b, is the amount $5,100 or more?' No box ('skip Part II-B and enter the smaller of line 17 or line 20 on line 27'); on-state /1.
'On line 16b, is the amount $5,100 or more?' Yes box; on-state /2.
Part II-C line 27 additional child tax credit, flows to Form 1040 line 28; widget row matches the printed '27' label rows.
